pages.title: PRAHAAR — India's first national counter-terrorism policy

facts.text: Released by: MHA on 23 February 2026 — ⚠ India's first-ever national counter-terrorism policy
facts.head: Policy

facts.text: Drafting announced November 2024; earlier National Policy and Action Plan for LWE (2015); Pahalgam attack (22 April 2025) spurred NIA–state coordination
facts.head: Policy

facts.text: Prevention; Response; Aggregating internal capacities; Human rights and rule-of-law processes; Countering radicalisation; Alignment with global efforts; Recovery and resilience (whole-of-society)
facts.head: Seven pillars

facts.text: Zero tolerance — deny funds, weapons, safe havens
facts.head: Provisions

facts.text: Threats on land, air (drones), water; critical sectors — power, railways, aviation, ports, defence, space, atomic energy
facts.head: Provisions

facts.text: CBRNED: Chemical, Biological, Radiological, Nuclear, Explosive, Digital
facts.head: Provisions

facts.text: Recognises cyber-attacks by nation-states, crypto funding, dark web
facts.head: Provisions

facts.text: ⚠ Does not link terrorism to any religion, ethnicity or civilisation
facts.head: Provisions

facts.text: Graded counter-radicalisation; prison de-radicalisation; legal experts from FIR stage; standardised state anti-terror structures
facts.head: Provisions
